decision.reason: The only evidence is the release-note line [ev-2e2644c3f5f9]. It says the OLM installation and release docs were removed, under BREAKING CHANGES. It does not say whether OLM-based installs, bundle publishing or upgrades are affected, or whether only the documentation went away. If only the docs changed, no environment is exposed. If OLM distribution stopped, OLM-managed installs are exposed. The proposed "installed via OLM" condition assumes the second reading without support. To decide, we need the content of PR #4617 or a statement on whether the OLM bundle or catalog is still published for 0.16.0.
